source.evidence: User-supplied organization snapshot. Profile/group observations and Relay-reported claims are distinguished in relay-charter.md. Not live availability, billing or dispatch authorization.

note: 19 reported bots, six teams. The owning bot stays in task/plan metadata; every new coordinator task and canonical result use relay/inbox and relay/outbox. One shared cloud Linux machine is not 19 isolated security boundaries.

2nd-b.note: Task/result bus: E:/2ndB/.bots/relay/inbox|outbox. Bots may propose code only in docs/drafts; do not edit app source.

boundary: Prefer an authorized local CLI/API/MCP and keep the /vibe coordinator. Use the Bot adapter for necessary cloud screens. Explicitly authorized reversible free preparation is permitted; current task scope, credential security and spend holds still apply. Login/2FA goes to Simon. Payment, ad activation, store submission, deletion, publication, external sending and subscription changes require approval.

delivery.note: Timing is Relay-reported, not a verified running scheduler. No automatic resend or routine creation.

unresolved_routing_keys.web-qa: No dedicated profile was observed. Cassius is QA, but exact web-qa routing is unverified; send an assignment clarification to Relay, not a fabricated Web QA bot.

retired_ids.compliance-watch: Previously withdrawn; no current profile in supplied snapshot.
